title: Java Beginner Mock Test 1
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for Java at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which statement accurately describes JDK in Java?

options.text: the JDK includes development tools such as javac
a JRE-only installation may not provide javac
The JVM chooses behavior randomly
It requires an external paid library

questions.explanation: the JDK includes development tools such as javac. Confirm the rule by compiling and running a minimal program.
